# runtime_registration_token (Data Source)

Retrieves the current, active registration token. This token is used to register new cluster nodes. Requires a valid Identity Token with Admin privileges.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runtime_registration_token" "current" {}

output "registration_token" {
  value     = data.runtime_registration_token.current.access_token
  sensitive = true
  description = "The current registration token for cluster node registration"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) The current, active registration token.
